text.en:
The above-described parcels of land located in Baguio City valued at Seven Million One
hundred forty-seven thousand four hundred forty pesos (P7,147,440.00) are hereby conveyed, transferred and
ceded to the Government Service Insurance System as additional contribution of the National Government to
augment the actuarial solvency of the System's Retirement Insurance Fund, on the condition that the GSIS
shall for its own account construct a convention center equipped with the essential facilities and amenities
necessary to service local, regional, and international conferences.

Any provision of law, executive order, rules and regulations inconsistent with this Decree is
hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 27th day of February, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-four.
